⚕ E.H. AROGYA SUTRA

DYNAMIC MEDICINE MAPPING — CURSOR PROMPT

Book se DYNAMIC mapping | Hardcoded NAHI | Admin Edit kar sake

⚠️ IMPORTANT — Cursor ko yeh samjhana hai

Document mein jo medicines likhi hain (S-1, A-1 etc.)
WOH SIRF EXAMPLE hain!
Cursor ko HARDCODE nahi karna hai!
Sab kuch Book se dynamically aayega!

FILE 1 — medicine_template.json (Empty Structure Only)

FILE: backend/data/medicine_template.json
Yeh sirf STRUCTURE hai — koi medicine data nahi.
Ollama aur Doctor milkar fill karenge.
Cursor is file mein koi medicine HARDCODE nahi karega!

⚠️ NOTE: Yeh EMPTY template hai — Example ke taur par:

// ⚠️ CURSOR KO BATANA HAI:

// Yeh file sirf STRUCTURE dikhati hai.

// Is mein koi REAL medicine data save MAT karo.

// Actual data SIRF book text se extract hoga.

// Doctor admin panel se edit kar sakta hai.

FILE 2 — bookToJsonMapper.js (Dynamic, No Hardcoding)

FILE: backend/scripts/bookToJsonMapper.js
⚠️ Is file mein koi medicine ka data HARDCODE nahi.
Sab kuch book text se Ollama extract karega.
Fallback mein bhi EMPTY structure save hogi.

⚠️ CURSOR KO STRICT INSTRUCTION:

// ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️ CURSOR — IMPORTANT WARNING ⚠️ ⚠️ ⚠️

//

// Is script mein medicine codes ki list hai

// (S-1, S-2, A-1 etc.) — YEH SIRF SEARCH KEYS hain!

//

// In codes ki properties (temperament, anatomy etc.)

// HARDCODE NAHI KARNI — book text se extract karni hai!

//

// Agar book mein S-1 ke baare mein kuch likha hai

// to Ollama use padhkar JSON banayega.

// Agar book mein kuch nahi mila to

// EMPTY structure save hogi — koi assumption nahi!

const axios  = require('axios');

const fs     = require('fs');

const path   = require('path');

const OLLAMA_URL  = process.env.OLLAMA_URL  || 'http://localhost:11434';

const MODEL       = process.env.OLLAMA_MODEL || 'llama3.2:3b';

const BOOK_DIR    = path.join(__dirname, '../data/book_chunks');

const INDEX_PATH  = path.join(__dirname, '../data/book_chunks/local_vector_index.json');

const OUTPUT_PATH = path.join(__dirname, '../data/medicine_knowledge_base.json');

// ════════════════════════════════════════

// Medicine CODES list — SIRF search keys!

// Properties book se aayengi — hardcoded nahi!

// ════════════════════════════════════════

const MEDICINE_CODES = [

// S-Group codes

{ code: 'S-1',   search_terms: ['scrofoloso 1', 's-1', 's1'] },

{ code: 'S-2',   search_terms: ['scrofoloso 2', 's-2', 's2'] },

// C-Group codes

{ code: 'C-1',   search_terms: ['canceroso 1', 'c-1', 'c1'] },

{ code: 'C-4',   search_terms: ['canceroso 4', 'c-4', 'c4'] },

{ code: 'C-6',   search_terms: ['canceroso 6', 'c-6', 'c6'] },

{ code: 'C-7',   search_terms: ['canceroso 7', 'c-7', 'c7'] },

{ code: 'C-8',   search_terms: ['canceroso 8', 'c-8', 'c8'] },

{ code: 'C-10',  search_terms: ['canceroso 10', 'c-10', 'c10'] },

// ⚠️ NOTE: Upar sirf CODE aur SEARCH TERMS hain

// Koi bhi medicine ki property (temperament, anatomy)

// hardcoded NAHI hai — sab book se aayega!

// ════════════════════════════════════════

// Book se text collect karo

// ════════════════════════════════════════

function loadIndex() {

try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(INDEX_PATH,'utf8')); }

catch(e) { return null; }

}

function scanTxtFiles(searchTerms) {

const dirs = [

path.join(__dirname,'../../book/extracted/doctor_supplied'),

path.join(__dirname,'../data/book_chunks'),

path.join(__dirname,'../../book/extracted'),

];

const found = [];

for(const dir of dirs){

if(!fs.existsSync(dir)) continue;

const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith('.txt'));

for(const file of files){

try{

const content = fs.readFileSync(path.join(dir,file),'utf8');

const lower   = content.toLowerCase();

if(searchTerms.some(t=>lower.includes(t.toLowerCase()))){

found.push(content.substring(0,900));

if(found.length>=8) return found;

}

}catch(e){}

}

}

return found;

}

function searchRAG(index, terms, topK=6) {

if(!index) return [];

const tkns = terms.flatMap(t=>t.toLowerCase().split(' ')).filter(t=>t.length>1);

return (index.chunks||[])

.map(c=>{

const low=[...(c.keywords||[]),(c.medicines||[])].join(' ').toLowerCase();

const sc = tkns.reduce((s,t)=>s+(low.includes(t)?4:0),0);

return {...c,sc};

})

.filter(c=>c.sc>0).sort((a,b)=>b.sc-a.sc).slice(0,topK);

}

function readChunk(filename) {

try{ return fs.readFileSync(path.join(BOOK_DIR,filename),'utf8').substring(0,700); }

catch(e){ return ''; }

}

// ════════════════════════════════════════

// Ollama ko strict prompt — Book se extract

// ════════════════════════════════════════

async function extractFromBook(medCode, searchTerms, bookText) {

const systemPrompt = `

You are an Electrohomeopathy book extractor.

STRICTLY extract information from the provided book text ONLY.

Do NOT use prior knowledge.

Do NOT assume or guess any values.

If information is not in book text, use null or empty array.

Output ONLY valid JSON.`;

const userPrompt = `

Medicine Code: ${medCode}

BOOK TEXT (extract ONLY from this):

===

${bookText.substring(0, 8000)}

===

TASK: Extract medicine information for '${medCode}' from above book text.

If the book does not mention something, use null or empty [].

DO NOT guess or use outside knowledge.

Return EXACTLY this JSON structure:

{

'medicine_name': 'from book or null',

'code': '${medCode}',

'group': 'group name from book or null',

'temperament': ['from book only, e.g. Lymphatic/Sanguine/Nervous/Mixed'],

'hindi_name': 'from book or null',

'verified_from_book': true,

'properties': {

'primary_action': 'from book text',

'action_hindi': 'Hindi description from book',

'anatomical_affinity': ['organs from book'],

'pathological_affinity': ['diseases from book']

},

'mapping_rules': [

{

'condition': 'disease from book',

'condition_hindi': 'Hindi condition from book',

'anatomy': 'affected organ from book',

'pathology': 'Acute or Chronic from book',

'symptoms': ['keywords from book'],

'dosage_protocol': {

'dilution': 'from book e.g. 1:9',

'potency': 'from book e.g. D10',

'frequency': 'from book e.g. 3 times a day',

'timing': 'from book e.g. Before meals',

'electricity': 'from book e.g. G.E.',

'rationale': 'exact reason from book text'

}

}

]

}`;

const resp = await axios.post(

`${OLLAMA_URL}/api/generate`,

{ model:MODEL, system:systemPrompt, prompt:userPrompt,

stream:false, format:'json',

options:{temperature:0.0, num_predict:1500, num_ctx:8192} },

{ timeout:120000 }

);

return resp.data.response||'';

}

function parseJSON(raw, code) {

try{

const clean=raw.replace(/```json/g,'').replace(/```/g,'').trim();

const s=clean.indexOf('{'); const e=clean.lastIndexOf('}');

if(s===-1||e===-1) return null;

const p=JSON.parse(clean.substring(s,e+1));

return {...p, code, source:'book-extracted',

extracted_at:new Date().toISOString()};

}catch(e){ return null; }

}

// ⚠️ Empty structure — NO hardcoded data

function emptyStructure(code) {

return {

medicine_name: null,

code: code,

group: null,

temperament: [],

hindi_name: null,

verified_from_book: false,

properties: {

primary_action: null,

action_hindi: null,

anatomical_affinity: [],

pathological_affinity: []

},

mapping_rules: [],

source: 'pending-book-extraction',

note: 'Book text nahi mila — admin manually fill kare',

admin_editable: true,

extracted_at: new Date().toISOString()

};

}

function save(db) {

fs.writeFileSync(OUTPUT_PATH,

JSON.stringify({

_info: {

description: 'EH Medicine Knowledge Base',

source: 'Extracted from book by Ollama',

note: 'DO NOT hardcode — book-extracted only'

},

medicines: db

}, null, 2), 'utf8');

}

// ════════════════════════════════════════

// MAIN

// ════════════════════════════════════════

async function run() {

console.log('E.H. BOOK → JSON MAPPER (Dynamic, No Hardcoding)');

const index = loadIndex();

let db = {};

try{

db = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(OUTPUT_PATH,'utf8')).medicines||{};

}catch(e){}

for(let i=0; i<MEDICINE_CODES.length; i++){

const {code, search_terms} = MEDICINE_CODES[i];

if(db[code]?.verified_from_book===true){

console.log(`✅ [${i+1}] ${code} — already verified`);

continue;

}

process.stdout.write(`\n[${i+1}/${MEDICINE_CODES.length}] ${code}...`);

// Collect book text

const parts = [];

if(index){

searchRAG(index,search_terms,6).forEach(c=>parts.push(readChunk(c.filename)));

}

scanTxtFiles(search_terms).forEach(t=>parts.push(t));

const bookText=[...new Set(parts)].filter(Boolean).join('\n---\n');

if(!bookText.trim()){

console.log(' ⚠️  No book text — empty structure saved');

db[code]=emptyStructure(code);  // ← Empty, NOT fallback data

save(db); continue;

}

try{

const raw    = await extractFromBook(code, search_terms, bookText);

const parsed = parseJSON(raw, code);

if(parsed&&parsed.mapping_rules?.length>0){

db[code]=parsed;

save(db);

console.log(` ✅ Extracted: ${parsed.mapping_rules.length} rules`);

} else {

console.log(' ⚠️  Extraction incomplete — empty saved');

db[code]=emptyStructure(code);  // ← Empty, NOT fallback data

save(db);

}

}catch(e){

console.log(` ❌ Error — empty saved`);

db[code]=emptyStructure(code);

save(db);

}

await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));

}

console.log('\nDONE! medicine_knowledge_base.json saved.');

}

run().catch(console.error);

FILE 3 — Admin Edit API (Doctor changes kar sake)

Doctor admin panel se medicine edit kar sake.
Book se jo data aaya wo doctor verify kare.
verified_from_book: true/false track hoga.

backend/routes/adminMedicine.js — add karo

const express = require('express');

const router  = express.Router();

const fs      = require('fs');

const path    = require('path');

const KB_PATH = path.join(__dirname,'../data/medicine_knowledge_base.json');

// GET /api/admin/medicines — List all

router.get('/', (req,res)=>{

try{

const kb = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(KB_PATH,'utf8'));

const list = Object.entries(kb.medicines).map(([code,med])=>({

code, medicine_name:med.medicine_name,

verified:med.verified_from_book,

rules_count:med.mapping_rules?.length||0,

source:med.source

}));

res.json({total:list.length, medicines:list});

}catch(e){ res.status(500).json({error:e.message}); }

});

// GET /api/admin/medicines/:code — Get one

router.get('/:code', (req,res)=>{

try{

const kb  = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(KB_PATH,'utf8'));

const med = kb.medicines[req.params.code];

if(!med) return res.status(404).json({error:'Not found'});

res.json(med);

}catch(e){ res.status(500).json({error:e.message}); }

});

// PUT /api/admin/medicines/:code — Doctor edit kare

router.put('/:code', (req,res)=>{

try{

const kb   = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(KB_PATH,'utf8'));

const code = req.params.code;

if(!kb.medicines[code])

return res.status(404).json({error:'Medicine not found'});

// Update fields

kb.medicines[code] = {

...kb.medicines[code],

...req.body,

code,  // code change nahi hogi

last_edited_by: 'doctor',

last_edited_at: new Date().toISOString(),

verified_from_book: req.body.verified_from_book||false

};

fs.writeFileSync(KB_PATH, JSON.stringify(kb,null,2),'utf8');

res.json({success:true, medicine:kb.medicines[code]});

}catch(e){ res.status(500).json({error:e.message}); }

});

// POST /api/admin/medicines/run-extraction

// Trigger book extraction

router.post('/run-extraction', async (req,res)=>{

try{

const {exec} = require('child_process');

exec('node scripts/bookToJsonMapper.js',

{cwd: path.join(__dirname,'../')},

(err,stdout,stderr)=>{

if(err) return res.json({success:false,error:err.message});

res.json({success:true, output:stdout.slice(-500)});

});

res.json({success:true, message:'Extraction started in background'});

}catch(e){ res.status(500).json({error:e.message}); }

});

module.exports = router;
